messages:
maya: hi all, i'm maya (started today, infra SWE). hitting a wall with SSO. okta asks me to enroll MFA but when i scan the QR in Okta Verify it says 'Device activation failed (400)'. tried twice. anyone know quick fixes? @jamal ?

it-bot: Welcome, maya! I've opened ticket IT-2029 for you. An IT engineer will respond shortly. If this is critical, run `/pager jamal`.

jamal: welcome aboard @maya :wave: usually that 400 happens when there's a stale device record or the shared secret didn't register. what phone/os are you on, and are you using Okta Verify app or trying to add a TOTP into 1Password?

maya: iphone 12, iOS 16. okta verify v6.1. tried scanning QR.

jamal: cool. try this quick checklist (works 90% of the time):
1) sign in at https://redwood.okta.com -> avatar -> Settings -> Extra verification -> remove any old devices
2) sign out of okta on desktop, sign back in and choose Set up -> Okta Verify
3) if QR scan fails click "Can't scan?" and copy the secret, then do Manual Setup in Okta Verify and paste it
4) alternate: create OTP in 1Password using the secret (we allow 1Password as fallback)

if that still fails, reply with a screenshot and i'll reset your MFA from the admin console and check device trust.

maya: tried removing old device but the console didn't show any device for my account. manual setup initially showed the same error when activating.

jamal: hmmm. i'll reset your factors now. give me 10m.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2029 updated by jamal. Action: Reset MFA factors. ETA: ~15 minutes.

ashley: welcome @maya! once you have SSO access, don't forget the Security Basics training in Learn@Redwood. Also check your spam folder for the 1Password org invite.

chris: hey @maya — once your email is live ping me and i'll add you to the infra GitHub team and the #eng-infra channel.

jamal: reset completed. try signing in again and doing Manual Setup (paste secret). if it errors still i'll flip the Device Trust rule for your org membership and try one more activation.

maya: ok that did it. manual setup + 1Password otp worked and i can access gmail now. thanks jamal and team :tada: :thumbsup:

chris: nice! congrats and welcome again. ping if you need repo access.

it-bot: Ticket IT-2029 closed by jamal.

maya: done. added to 1Password and finished initial setup. starting on the README and will DM for dev env access. thanks all :)
